answer: In an AI-agent economy, Sybil attacks are resisted by mandating that every agent periodically solves a unique cipher puzzle tied to its identity key, drawn from a shared computational dune of escalating difficulty. Creating fake identities forces the attacker to expend real compute cycles on each one, collapsing the fable that identities are free and making large-scale fakery economically ruinous as costs compound faster than any gain.
